verdict.rationale: Brex's own docs describe issuing vendor-specific cards with per-transaction limits and approval flows. Its developer docs describe issuing virtual cards, including purpose-scoped cards such as a monthly-resetting WFH stipend, and a community user praises the 'dynamic credit card generator.' missing for 10: explicit evidence that vendor-specific cards are virtual and created instantly, a documented example of a purpose-scoped card for ad spend, and in-depth first-party docs on card scoping controls.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can instantly create virtual cards scoped to a specific purpose like ad spend or a single vendor

citations.quote: Issue vendor-specific cards for any teams with per-transaction limits and procurement approval flows.
you can use this integration to create virtual cards for a WFH stipend where the card limit resets every month
I really liked the dynamic credit card generator
